title: rhynchospora foliosa

It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Rhynchospora foliosa for medicinal purposes.
